results.content: ## Kubatana's Post. ### **Kubatana**. The Financial Education Facilitators (FEFs) will be responsible for providing basic financial education to 2,373 people in 5 wards of Masvingo district (wards 12, 13, 15, 24 and 25). Primary duties will involve field level operations with frequent visits to project communities in rural areas to meet with project beneficiaries, working closely with community leaders and partners in the field. Stakeholder and community orientation and sensitisation; Mobilize target community to fully participate in all aspects of the project; Conduct/Provide Basic financial education (including Village Savings and Lending) trainings; Conduct/Provide Basic value chain and market linkages (including with SAMS) trainings; Conduct/ provide Basic insurance (including weather index insurance) trainings; Responsible for monitoring and evaluation of VSL activities in targeted communities; Prepare monitoring and progress reports, which include updates on key activities/achievements using quantitative data as well as qualitative information; Represent SNV at District level meetings.
